A halberd covered in rust due to prolonged exposure to the elements.|Services|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 5 |durability = 15 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Rusty Halberd}} Rusty Halberds are [[Weapon]]s that can be found in the [[Great Hyrule Forest]] and [[Hyrule Field]], particularly around ruins. They were potentially used by [[Hylian Knight]]s, before they deteriorated due to exposure to the elements. Because of their rusted nature, they have a very low durability. [[Rock Octorok]]s will inhale Rusty Halberds that are placed in front of them, spitting out a cleaned counterpart.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}} The [[Item]] has a 50% chance to be a [[Traveler's Spear]], a 35% chance to be a [[Soldier's Spear]], a 10% chance to be a [[Knight's Halberd]], and a 5% chance to be a [[Royal Halberd]]. Being made of metal, Rusty Halberds will attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. However, they are unable to burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. Finally, Rusty Halberds can be manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. Rusty Halberds are part of the archetype of equipment known as [[Rusty Gear]], which is a group of deteriorated Weapons with low [[Durability]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_021" |Life = 15 |Power = 5 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 6 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 7 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 7 |BuyingPrice = 20 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Spear |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Rusty Halberd}} {{Stub|TotK}} Rusty Halberds reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:AoC Rusty Halberd Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Rusty Halberd icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Rusty Gear * Spear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Halberds, Rusty Gear, Spears, Weapons |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
